purpose: Teach: ヨーグルト/ミシン/見合い/白黒/なかでも/慰め/日ごろ/ちまっ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、朝のヨーグルト、メニューに加えたの、いいアイディアだよね。
lines.en: Aoi, that idea to add morning yogurt to the menu — that was really smart.
lines.style: Warm, genuine admiration. Bright opening on the name. Soft lean forward. Conversational pace, landing on the compliment with steady affection.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。お祖母ちゃんのミシン、まだ使ってるよ、私、最近。
lines.en: Yeah. I've actually been using Grandma's sewing machine lately.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly distant. Quiet voice like she's just noticed this about herself. Soft exhale before 'lately.' Eyes looking somewhere past the present moment.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: いとこ、見合い結婚したって、聞いたよ、最近、私。
lines.en: I heard recently that my cousin had an arranged marriage.
lines.style: Gentle reflection. Measured pace. Sitting with the weight of it. Not leading anywhere, just offering it. Warm curiosity beneath, not judgment.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 店の写真、白黒でアレンジ、お洒落な雰囲気、出るよ。
lines.en: Black-and-white photos of the cafe — if we arrange them that way, the whole place would have such a polished look.
lines.style: Animated but purposeful. Building the image as she speaks. Slight rise in energy on 'polished.' Forward momentum, like she's seeing it come together.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 秋の果物、なかでも、柿、私、一番好きなのよ。
lines.en: Of all the autumn fruits, I think I love persimmons the most.
lines.style: Soft, almost private admission. Warm tone without performance. Gentle landing on 'most' — not emphatic, just true. Small smile underneath.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 失恋の慰め、メイちゃん、来てくれて、嬉しかったよ、葵としても。
lines.en: I was so glad you came by when I was dealing with that breakup. It really meant something.
lines.style: Genuine gratitude, unguarded. Steady eye contact. Warm but not effusive. The honesty of someone saying what matters without overexplaining.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 日ごろの感謝、葵に、伝えたいんだ、本当に、いつもありがとう。
lines.en: I really do want to tell you how grateful I am for you — every day. Thank you.
lines.style: Tender and deliberate. Slows down slightly. Not rushed. Meets her eyes. The kind of thing said quietly but with full weight behind it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 昔のメイちゃん、ちまっこくて、可愛かったわよね、子供の頃。
lines.en: You were so tiny and adorable when you were little, Mei.
lines.style: Warm nostalgia, slightly teasing. Soft laugh underneath. Eyes bright with memory. Affectionate tone — the way you talk about someone you watched grow up.
